Synopsis:
    Fed Governor Barr and Chair Warsh are signaling a conditional rate hike at the Sept 15-16 FOMC meeting. The key trigger is whether inflation shows sufficient progress toward the 2% target. The economy is described as solid, with AI-driven investment and stable labor markets. Markets are pricing a 25bps hike, with the fed funds rate currently at 3.50%-3.75%. Officials are broadly aligned on acting decisively if inflation does not moderate.
